brief:
Greens for Palestine has encouraged people to join the UK Green party specifically to back a motion declaring "Zionism is racism," The Guardian reported. The group has links to activists who have characterized pro-Israel members as "infiltrators" requiring removal from the party.

The organization has been working to advance the controversial position within Green party structures. The effort reflects ongoing internal divisions within the party over Israel-Palestine policy and party membership composition.

title: Green party activists push motion equating Zionism with racism
